SWIM2.title: SWIM2-Inputs: Are all documents needed for the review available in their required state? (e.g., source code, SW detailed design, static test reports such as MISRA checks, Polyspace, compiler warnings, model advisor for MBD, ...)

SWIM11.title: SWIM11-Global Data/Variables: Are globals avoided or their use clearly documented as per detailed design? Is data used appropriately and change local to avoid repetitive definitions?

SWIM12.title: SWIM12-a2l: Are all parameters/variables implemented correctly and in the right location with the correct data type (esp. for calibration)?

SWIM10.title: SWIM10-Identifiers: Naming convention fulfilled (signals/variables)? No identifiers rely on significance of >31 characters.

SWIM18.title: SWIM18-Completeness vs limits: Does the code follow defined limits? Are deviations justified in the Code metrics report?

SWIM8.title: SWIM8-Style guide & clarity: Implemented artifact sufficiently clear and understandable for intended readers? Proper commenting, no unnecessary complexity; implementation structure referenced in PDP.

SWIM6.title: SWIM6-Definitions: Is it checked that all definition of Code and Data area are included in the defined Program/Memory Assignment and not duplicated or shadowed?

SWIM14.title: SWIM14-Type conversion: For explicit casts, has value range been checked (no under/overflow, no re-interpretation issues)? Examples: cast from signed -> unsigned; long -> short; etc.

SWIM4.title: SWIM4-Completeness: Is it checked that the Code is complete, covers the Design, and complements all parts of the design? Is there no part of the implementation that is not covered in the SW Design?

SWIM13.title: SWIM13-Correctness: (Source) code free of obviously wrong/obsolete statements?

SWIM15.title: SWIM15-Division: For all divisions, has the denominator been tested to be non-zero? (If zero can be excluded, justify in comment.)

SWIM1.title: SWIM1-Is the Software Implementation Guideline & review process checked & followed by the developer for SW unit construction (source code) & technical review?

SWIM7.title: SWIM7-Traceability: Is correct bidirectional traceability established per the Detail design & implementation guideline to design elements and all implemented requirements? (e.g., naming conventions between Model / Source Code, code comments, SW Detailed Design).

SWIM16.title: SWIM16-Complete: Are all design elements implemented? Any unused interfaces removed?

SWIM9.title: SWIM9-Complexity: Is cyclomatic complexity/LOC below the specified limit? (e.g., Polyspace metric limit <= 20).

SWIM17.title: SWIM17-Notation & documentation: Are code and associated documents (compiler warnings, Polyspace) properly commented and documented per guideline and naming conventions?

SWIM3.title: SWIM3-Baseline planning: Is the artifact to be reviewed checked in or delivered in the stream?
